collection.title: VW Caravelle T4 1990 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Caravelle T4 1990 to 2003 model requires a 21" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
